$comment: Skills installed on this PC (Claude Code's skills folder, ~/.agents/skills) are copied to agents that can't read those folders: Antigravity (into its skills folder) and Codex (into ~/.codex/skills, only skills not already in ~/.agents/skills). Your own skills belong in config/skills. Earlier sources win when two have the same skill. Linked folders are never mirrored. A '*' path segment picks the most recently updated match.
